title: Capstone: RPG Battle Arena
description:
```
Round 3
  Thorn (Warrior)  HP [#######...] 70/100   uses Shield Bash on Vex: 14 damage
  Vex (Mage)       HP [####......] 41/100   casts Fireball on Thorn: 22 damage
```
hints: Put what every character shares in the base class: `takeDamage(int)`, `isAlive()`, `hpBar()`. The subclasses only decide *what* to do on their turn.
An HP bar of 10 characters: `int filled{ hp * 10 / maxHp };` then `std::string(filled, '#') + std::string(10 - filled, '.')`.
Give each special ability a cooldown: a counter that the base class lowers each turn, and a special that is only used when it is 0.
requirements: An abstract `Character` with name, HP, a pure virtual `takeTurn(Character& enemy)` and a virtual `specialAbility(Character& enemy)`
`Warrior`, `Mage` and `Rogue`, each with its own attack and special ability
A battle loop between two characters until one falls, with HP bars
The characters are created from the player's choice and held as `std::unique_ptr<Character>`
stretch: Status effects (poison, shield) as their own small class hierarchy with `apply`, `tick` and `expired`, and teams of three.
